identity: University of Groningen (Rijksuniversiteit Groningen), English full-time BSc Scheikundige Technologie, RIO 56960, registry row 220, standard single Chemical Engineering degree.
sourceUse: The current TER index labels the supplied Chemical Engineering appendix 2026–2027 despite the older running footer. The dated Ocasys programme list independently confirms the unit codes, credits and statuses. The general programme page provides context but does not govern the course sequence. The double degree, transition exemptions and optional industrial visits entry are outside this ordinary 180 EC plan.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Process Control & Dynamics
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Differential equations, Laplace transforms, dynamic response and feedback support a limited Linear Systems alignment. Industrial controllers and control architectures remain specific to Groningen.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Product Technology
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Structured product design and cost and feasibility overlap with consumer design. Groningen adds quantitative structure-property and processing technology.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Biochemical Technology
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Proteins, enzymes, carbohydrates and biochemical techniques, with an integrated practical and chemical engineering applications.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Sustainability Projects
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Preliminary life-cycle assessment and process diagrams in a chemical product or process case support alignment to UCR Life Cycle Analysis.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Green Chemistry: Technological, Societal and Ethical Aspects
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Green chemistry, ethics, science policy and responsible innovation support bounded alignment to governance, which lacks the discipline focus.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Process Design
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Chemical flowsheet, mass and energy balances, plant control, costs and safety. UCR consumer design and feedback methods cannot substitute for this.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Bachelor Research Project
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Independent research questions, experimentation or simulation, report and presentation. The formal appendix establishes research-project entry.

catalogueCorroboration.title: Linear Algebra & Multivariable Calculus for Chemistry
catalogueCorroboration.finding: Matrices, vectors and multivariable calculus. Linear Algebra supplies one of the two parts.

Compulsory Chemical Engineering research project; entry requires the completed first year and at least 130 EC in the curriculum.

progression.year-two: Positive study advice in Chemical Engineering or Chemistry.
progression.practicals: Synthesis and Analysis follows Molecules and Organic Chemistry 1. The first Chemical Engineering Practical follows that synthesis practical.
progression.advanced: Industrial Organic Chemistry follows Organic Chemistry 1; Physical Transport 2 follows Transport; General Process Equipment and Multiphase Reactors follow Single-Phase Reactors; Process Design follows Separation Processes and General Process Equipment.
progression.research-project: Completed first year, at least 130 EC, programme sent for Board approval a month in advance, and coordinator application for the standard period.
progression.electives: 15 EC in the third year. Listed options count; other courses need approval, with the complete university minor exception stated by Ocasys.
